prompts.surfaces:
Create a production GAME UI ASSET SPRITE SHEET on a genuinely TRANSPARENT background, NOT a mockup screen. Use Image 1 (approved hero) and Image 2 (component kit) as exact material/style references: deep navy/cobalt enamel, cream inner keyline, coral trim/extrusion, mint illuminated edges, upper-left highlights, down-right dimensional shadow. The goal is reusable blank components into which the game will draw LIVE TEXT. NO WORDS, LETTERS, NUMBERS, LABELS OR CAPTIONS anywhere.
Strict layout: a clean 2 COLUMN by 3 ROW grid, SIX isolated components, equal-size invisible cells, wide transparent gutters, no overlap. Overall landscape canvas approximately 2048 wide x 1536 high. Each component centered within its own cell, all content safely away from cell edges.
Row1 left: blank navy TITLE SIGN, preserve the original hero's up-right tilted skewed rectangle silhouette, thin cream+coral perimeter, small golden star at upper-left, large mint/navy saucer protruding from the right with a mint orbit ribbon sweeping out left and across lower edge. Main face entirely blank and spacious, for a dynamic title heading. This is the same dynamic original form, not a die-cut letter silhouette.
Row1 right: blank PRIMARY SAUCER ACTION, original hero's oval blue flying saucer START RUN button shape, mint luminous rim and undercarriage, blue glass dome above, huge empty dark-blue central face for LIVE button label, two small gold star glints toward outer tips. Face blank.
Row2 left: blank SECONDARY CREAM BUTTON, wide rounded-trapezoid capsule, cream face, navy thin inner outline, coral outer rim, two tiny silver corner rivets, shallow navy shadow; no icons inside, generous empty face.
Row2 right: blank NAVY PANEL, wide rounded rectangle with gentle enamel texture, cream inner border and coral thin outside rim, four tiny corner rivets, clean empty central surface. Straight edges allow nine-slice scaling.
Row3 left: blank CREAM CARD PANEL, wide rounded rectangle cream face, thin navy inner rim and coral outer edge, four small corner rivets, shallow navy extrusion, all empty. Straight edges allow nine-slice scaling.
Row3 right: blank BLUEPRINT ICON TILE, square rich cobalt schematic-blue field with subtle fine grid, cream metal keyline, four tiny silver corner rivets. No illustration, text or symbol inside.
Keep the same border weights, rivet style, shadow direction and finish in all six pieces. No huge bevels, screws inside text area, extra components, hero logo, background scene, visible grid separators or framing board. Every pixel outside the SIX separate objects must be alpha-transparent.
prompts.icons:
Production GAME UI ICON SPRITE SHEET with genuinely transparent background. Match the supplied Human Resources hero and component sheet exactly: bold simplified navy/cream pictograms, small mint illumination, consistent enamel finish, upper-left light, same optical weight, playful retro alien science equipment. No background squares or frames around icons: game draws the reusable navy/blueprint tile behind these. Crisp silhouettes that read at 24–40px, restrained shading, no fussy mechanical detail. NO TEXT, LETTERS, NUMBERS, CAPTIONS OR LABELS.
Strict invisible 6 COLUMN x 6 ROW grid, 36 equally sized cells, overall square image approx1536x1536. Each icon fills about65% of its cell with generous transparent margin. No touching or overlapping neighbouring cells. Exactly these icons, one per cell, in reading order:
Row1: (1) flying saucer credit token, (2) defensive shield, (3) saucer with tractor beam, (4) laser emitter with three mint rays, (5) farm barn and field, (6) settings gear.
Row2: (7) crossed wrench and hammer, (8) speaker with sound waves, (9) hand with vibration waves, (10) slow orbit planet for reduced motion, (11) LEFT triangle arrow, (12) RIGHT triangle arrow.
Row3: (13) two pause bars, (14) double-chevron dash burst, (15) stopwatch, (16) score trophy, (17) blueprint rolled paper, (18) closed padlock.
Row4: (19) bold check mark in mint, (20) information circle with simple dot-and-stem information mark, (21) file folder, (22) backup disk with down arrow, (23) reroll die, (24) rail lens tube.
Row5: (25) electric arc coil, (26) three orbiting drones, (27) concentric EMP pulse ring, (28) beam splitter with three divergent rays, (29) tractor lens magnifying ring, (30) heavy cable winch and hook.
Row6: (31) reactor energy chamber, (32) reserve battery with bolt, (33) three small repair robots, (34) reflective mirror shield, (35) twin vector thruster nozzles, (36) bounty scanner radar.
Keep all cream strokes and mint accents consistent with the approved kit. Arrows/check/pause shapes can be simple solid cream/mint. Every outside pixel should be alpha transparent, not white or checkerboard. No sheet background, no separators, no drop shadow beyond each icon's silhouette.
prompts.logo:
Extract ONLY the large upper HUMAN RESOURCES title sign from this exact approved mobile home-screen image, as a reusable game-logo asset with a genuinely transparent background. Preserve the complete original tilted navy sign silhouette, cream HUMAN / coral RESOURCES custom lettering, tiny saucer/beam inside the A, crisp offset shadows, coral/cream border, yellow starbursts, the large mint/navy flying saucer protruding from the upper-right, and the entire mint elliptical orbit ribbon extending out left. Reproduce the supplied sign faithfully, without redesigning, straightening or changing its font/colours.
Remove everything else: farmland scenery, trees, barn, characters, central scene UFO/cow, credit/progress cards, lower location selector and all buttons. The output contains ONE isolated logo sign only, tightly but safely framed with transparent space around every tip and orbit edge. No new outline, extra glow, rectangle background, checkerboard or lettering changes. Original appearance and proportions, clean alpha edge, professional high resolution for an in-game title asset.

intent: Reusable transparent original art for live native UI components. Recipe owns cropping and packing; cooked files belong under build.
